values: 一名枪剑术高超的游侠，擅长针对敌方输出最高的角色，并制造大量伤害。
A master Rogue wielding a sword lance with unmatched skill, specializes in eliminating the enemy's top damage dealer with devastating, pinpoint strikes.
Divine Light shall cleanse the world.
Judgment has come. Evil shall perish.
Hmm? Something's wrong. Time to go.
Divine Light shine upon this gift!
Justice... it still waits. The scales remain unbalanced.
Humans and their indulgences... fascinating, if fleeting.
即使是世界上最坚固的盾牌，阿塔利娅手中的长枪也能将它轻易刺穿。
No shield, no matter how mighty, can withstand the piercing force of Athalia's lance.
阿塔利娅很少聆听许愿者的祈求——除非对方身上沾染着与恶魔相似的气息，她会直接加以惩戒。
Athalia seldom heeds the pleas of wishmakers, but when the taint of Hypogean influence clings to them, her judgment is swift and merciless.
如果时刻保持最高速度，阿塔利娅一天之内可以围绕伊索米亚飞行七圈。
Athalia's speed is unmatched. She can circle the entirety of Esperia seven times in a single day, leaving only a blur in her wake.
阿塔利娅从不怀疑神兵们对艾雅女神的信仰，但她自认为是所有神兵中最为忠诚的那个。
While she never questions the faith of the other Divine Weapons in Dura, Athalia holds herself as the most fervent disciple, her devotion burning brighter than the rest.
曾经有一个孩子问阿塔利娅，她走路的时候双脚会不会疼，但阿塔利娅一直没能理解“疼痛”这个词的意思。
Once, a child asked if her feet hurt from walking. Athalia, who had never known pain, could only stare in silent confusion.
“记得有一次阿塔利娅从我身边路过，我甚至都没来得及看清她，只感觉一阵狂风吹了过去，还差点吹乱我的发型。”萨基塔里斯抱怨。
"Athalia once raced past me so fast, all I felt was a gust of wind. It nearly messed up my hair!" —Dionel
即使面对恶魔，阿塔利娅也很少流露出情绪起伏。
Even in the face of Hypogeans, Athalia's expression remains unreadable.
一个未知来源的统计结果显示，当阿塔利娅开口说话时，这句话有83%的概率包含“裁决”这个词。
An anonymous study reveals that when Athalia speaks, there's an 83% chance the word "judgment" will leave her lips.
据一位不愿公开姓名的半神透露，在艾雅女神消失之时，阿塔利娅落下了一滴连她自己都没察觉到的泪。
According to a Celestial who wished to remain anonymous, when the goddess Dura disappeared, Athalia shed a single tear.
面对暗中学习黑魔法的人，阿塔利娅同样会毫不犹豫地进行裁决。正是因为她的存在，黑魔法只能在有限的范围内传播。
Athalia's relentless pursuit of justice extends to those who dabble in dark magic. It is because of her presence that dark magic can only spread within a limited scope.
我在这间屋内见到了恶魔，应当立刻执行裁决！
A Hypogean lurks in this room. It's time to carry out judgment without delay!
阿塔利娅 & 斯克嘉莉德
Humans and their indulgences... fascinating, if fleeting.
